name: Majir
description: Stop leaving money on the table when you shop. Majir finds every coupon, promo code, deal, discount, reward, and cashback offer for the stores you buy from, and tracks the credits, gift cards, and offers already sitting in your inbox and wallet so they get used before they expire. Ask Claude to search Majir's catalog, compare prices and savings on a purchase, check your saved offers, and get a Majir-tracked redemption link with the right coupon code from the offer itself. Majir shares structured offer fields only, never your raw emails.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Majir to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Majir to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.majir.shop/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Majir MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Majir provides these MCP tools: get_my_offer, get_offer, list_my_offers, redeem_my_offer, search_my_offers, and search_offers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Majir?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Majir in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Majir requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Majir is developed by Majir Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
